messages:
anna.devex: Quick UX thread — compact run history + tool-calling flow feels a bit dense on narrow screens. Inline function defs push important info below the fold.

sam.ux: Yup. My initial thought: collapse long param lists by default, show a short summary row. e.g. `Show params (2)` toggle.

frank.f: Implementation note: collapsing has perf + keyboard-nav implications. If we animate height it causes layout thrash. Bad for 100+ runs. Bad overlap with tool badges near the timestamp too.

maria.a11y: Accessibility nits: toggles must expose `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Also ensure the badge icon contrast meets AA (current token is ~3:1). Screen reader should announce "details" when expanded.

tyler.prod: From product: we want immediate access to the last 3 invocations without expanding. Can we do a densified compact row showing model, tool name, status, and micro-timestamp? Expand for full schema.

anna.devex: Proposal sketch: default = compact row (model | tool | status | mini-ts). Add an affordance "Show details" that expands inline to reveal truncated schema snippet + param summary + a small "Open schema" link. Keep only 1-2 lines of schema in compact view.

sam.ux: Copy tweak: prefer label "Show details" over "Expand". "Open schema" vs "View schema" — which reads better? I vote "Open schema" when it navigates a modal.

frank.f: DOM plan: `ul.run-list > li.run-item[data-expanded]` — use CSS grid to rearrange columns and collapse to a single-column stacked layout under 640px. For animations I'll avoid height transitions; prefer scaleY/opacity on an absolutely positioned panel to avoid reflow. Will prototype.

maria.a11y: Also: ensure keyboard focus moves into expanded content and that the expanded content appears immediately after the header in the DOM (reading order). Add `aria-live` for status changes so SR users get explicit feedback for tool-call success/failure.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: preview build published: `run-history-compact-ui` (#4321). URL: https://ci.internal/builds/4321 — includes compact rows + basic collapse.

tyler.prod: :thumbsup: Acceptance criteria: expand/collapse <200ms perceived, keyboard nav (tab to toggle, press enter/space to open), SR reads header + new details, and mobile density test (3 runs visible above the fold on iPhone SE).

anna.devex: I'll add a checklist to the PR description and a short screenshot of the compact vs expanded states. Frank, any known blockers besides the animation approach?

frank.f: Only timing. Might need to swap a layout-driven animation for transform-only to keep 60fps. Also will add a tiny debounce on rapid toggles.

maria.a11y: One more: color of the "Open schema" link must be underlined or otherwise distinguishable for users who have colorblindness + low contrast settings.

sam.ux: I'll update the mock and the copy. Tagging @frank.f when mocks are in Figma.

anna.devex: Thanks — leaving the thread open for one more pass. I'll run a quick handheld test once we have the preview build.
